notes.title: Toy Soldiers HD 2.1.0 Patch
notes.notes:
Online Play
·         Fixed issues with match making and online sign in status so the player is recognized as online and able to play online match.
·         Fixed random crash attempting to join Quick Match and Private Match play.
·         Fixed issues with leaderboard stats properly updating.
·         Fixed game desync issues.
·         Improved Tank and Airplane handling and control.

Radom crashes
·         Fixed random crashes reported.

Save Data
·         Fixed issue with progress sometimes being lost after playing split screen mode.

Tsar Tank Boss
·         Fixed issue where the level ends once the boss appears. 

Double Turrets
·         Fixed issues here the player can sometimes place more than one turret on a placement location.

Level Completion - Back Button
·         Fixed issue with being to exit to the main menu from the end of level results screen. Back button function s and player can back up and/or continue. 

Expansion Level Progress
·         Fixed issue with campaign progression sometimes not being able to properly access new expansion levels added to the campaign.

Achievements and Golden Cubes
·         Fixed issue with all Achievements and Golden Cubes being achieved and collected.

PC Frame Rate
·         PC frame rate running at 60 fps for both campaign and multi-player.

General Improvements 
·         Aiming/Bullet trajectories and targeting reticle behavior
·         Camera movement in game movement and use
·         Turret user control improvement pass
·         Turret selecting/de-selecting
·         Turret tracking and movement
·         Adjustments made to improve in-game level raking and scoring
·         Vehicle respawn restored in most levels/places.
·         Improved post effects and lighting
·         UI Fixes/Polish

o   Redid level camera fly ins
o   Polish pass on LEVEL SELECT MENU
o   Polish pass on Victory Screen
o   Polish pass on Surrender Screen
o   Polish pass on Stat Screen layout
o   Adjusted layouts and Increased font sizes in many places for readability

notes.title: Big Multiplayer Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
We would like to begin by saying a big thanks to our Steam squad for the patience you've shown while waiting for this first major update.

The team has been hard at work since launch to make sure this update meets everyone's expectations and that process has been more difficult than first expected so your understanding and support has been a great motivator for us all!

Multiplayer matchmaking is fixed. Player Sign-in detection is fixed. Quick Matches and Private Match mode are working. We took the opportunity to make updates that correct behavior at the Tsar Tank boss, turret placements that weren't behaving as expected and Tank & Airplane controls too. In fact, there have been lots of little tweaks and improvements to complement the big multiplayer update. See below for a more complete list of patch notes.

[b]Please note[/b]: We have experienced a crash at boot on one machine running the latest Windows 11 beta (22H2 beta) so please exercise caution if you're also on a beta OS.

If you have any feedback please let us know on Discord: [url=https://discord.io/accelerategames]Join our Discord![/url]

notes.title: An update from the Accelerate Games & Signal Studios Family
notes.notes:
We appreciate your patience and support since the launch of Toy Soldiers: HD on PlayStation, Xbox and PC.

The team have been working tirelessly to rectify issues reported by the community and we will be submitting an update for all platforms in the new year. 

For PC players on Steam, we have enabled a public beta to preview the update before it goes live. See the thread below for the list of fixes and details on how to access the beta on Steam:

[h1]Update Notes[/h1]
Significant polish and updates to the game including fixing camera issues, controller issues and updates to UI. Addressed issues reported by the community including:
[list]
[*]Online multiplayer connectivity.
[*]Adjusting the level player-controlled vehicle respawning - this was strategically updated throughout the game. 
[*]Improvements have been made to airplane handling for keyboard and mouse.
[*]Fixed level unlock issues.
[*]Fixed the instant defeat/level win on level 3.
[*]Fixes have been made to improve consistent 60 FPS in the single-player campaign.
[/list]

[h1]How to access the Public Beta[/h1]
Follow these steps to access the update via the public beta:
[list]
[*]Right-click on the Toy Soldiers: HD tile in your Steam library
[*]Select Properties
[*]Select Betas
[*]On the dropdown menu select 'PublicBeta'
[*]The update will then start to download to your PC. 
[*]Please report any issues in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1446160/discussions/1/]Feedback/Support[/url] subforum or on the [url=https://discord.gg/signalstudios]Signal Studios Discord[/url]
[*]You can opt-out of the Beta at any time by repeating the steps above and selecting Betas 'None'. 
[/list]

From the team, we wish you a happy holiday season and we will keep you updated on the progress of the updates in the new year!
